learning_outcomes.text: Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.

Identify, formulate and solve engineering problems in their specialty; choose and apply appropriately established analytical, computational and experimental methods; recognize the importance of social, health and safety, environmental, economic and industrial constraints.
Knowledge of the social, health and safety, environmental, economic and industrial implications of engineering practice.
Ability to collect and interpret data and manage complex concepts within their specialty, to make judgments that involve reflection on ethical and social issues.
Applies methods, techniques, regulations, etc. typical of the engineering profession in known contexts.
Makes decisions and assesses the possible consequences of the selected alternative.
Coordinates their work with other team members, contributes to the development of tasks and the creation of a good working environment within their team.

syllabus_topics: Change of era, era of change
Origin of consumer society (Fordism) and development (neoliberalism)
teaching_methods: Individual study and work, tests, exams and/or control points
Professor's presentation in class, in participatory sessions, of concepts and procedures associated with the subjects
Computer simulation practices, individually and/or in teams
Tutoring and follow-up sessions for training activities
Workshops, debates, seminars, case studies, role-playing games, etc.
Resolution of multidisciplinary exercises or case studies in teams

assessment_methods.method: Individual written and oral tests for evaluating technical competencies of the subject
Reports on exercise completion, case studies, computer practices, simulation practices, and laboratory practices
Individual written, coding/programming, and oral tests for evaluating technical competencies of the subject

assessment_rules: For the individual written and oral tests (70% component), there are no recovery mechanisms. No other specific grading formulas or minimum marks are provided.
